title: The seven stories of the sources pilot: six with their primary source checked and quoted, Jung's left out because the source is in copyright.
summary: From the review page's comments collection, pulled 2026-10-22. John rated all seven stories (6 to 8) and left a general note.

comments.note: This sentence is awkward: "All of these stories come from one podcast, American Alchemy, hosted by Jesse Michels." as I think we've discussed, the whole thing is currently based on AA, and though we may expand, for now it's strange. Could exist somewhere central, but not in a particular story. Otherwise good.
Quite solid on the whole, we can use these patterns and scale.

Also solid, there's a chance they were referring to another part of his writings, which is partly their fault for being vague, but we should do a slight hedge that (if this is the writing being referred to, then it was a narrower sense) or similar language to that.
